## Release — backlog-campaign v0.28.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.28.0

#### The campaign dashboard is built from campaign state

- The status page is generated on every refresh from the campaign's own state, so no file is kept by hand. The page leads with your next move beside what blocks the run, then a five-column board (in review, blocked, not started, parked, done) with a workstream filter, then workstreams, scope, config and your decisions ([#1150](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1150)).
- The scope lives in `config.json` `campaign_scope`, and your decisions in `owner-decisions.json`. Both are written only by the new `bun run record` command, which validates the input and writes atomically.
- The headline and the blockers come from the checkpoint's `## Headline` and `## Blocking the run` sections. When the checkpoint has none, both are generated from the counts and say so.
- `bun run status --data` writes the datasets the page reads. `--html` and the text status show the same facts.

#### The dashboard works on every forge

- Review verdict, CI and mergeability of each PR now come through the forge adapter of the configured forge, so a Gitea or GitLab campaign gets the same cards as a GitHub one. Before, they were read over `gh` only and every PR on a Gitea campaign said "CI not checked" ([#1152](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1152)).
- A card says "not checked" only when the forge was not asked, or when the reads for that PR failed. The cap is unchanged: 15 PRs per refresh.
- A merged campaign PR that no queue entry names now counts as done on the board and in its workstream, from the campaign start date on.
- A queue entry that the forge contradicts, such as "in review" for a PR that is merged, shows as the forge has it. It is listed as drift in `--json` and as one warning line in "Blocking the run", and the next sync brings the queue in line.
- A checkpoint section is matched on a heading that starts its line. A note that mentions `## Headline` in the middle of a sentence no longer replaces the page's headline.

#### The queue shows what it holds

- The state write guard rejects a queue status or phase outside the documented values, and the status page lists any entry that still carries one instead of dropping it ([#1147](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1147)).
- Open PRs that no queue entry names are listed, so work opened without an issue is no longer invisible.
